_template_notes.about: Template for op25-docker. Replace the example values below with YOUR P25 system's details, then restart op25. Full walkthrough: docs/SETUP.md.
_template_notes.devices: args 'rtl=<index>' selects the RTL-SDR dongle; run SDR -> Scan for devices in the web UI to find the index. 'frequency' is the receive center frequency in Hz (set it to your control channel). 'ppm' corrects crystal drift (0 to start).
_template_notes.channels: 'frequency' in Hz; 'destination' must match a stream 'udp_port' in stream.json, e.g. udp://127.0.0.1:23456 <-> udp_port 23456. demod/filter/symbol-rate values are P25 defaults; leave them unless you know otherwise.
_template_notes.trunking.chans: 'sysname': any label. 'control_channel_list': control channel in MHz (comma-separate alternates for CC hunting). 'nac': system Network Access Code in hex (0x...). 'sysid'/'wacn': optional, learned from the control channel if left empty. 'phase2_tdma': 1 if the system uses Phase 2 TDMA. 'modulation': 'cqpsk' for 700/800 MHz, 'fm' for VHF/UHF. 'whitelist'/'blacklist': comma-separated talkgroup IDs to restrict or block decoding.
_template_notes.verbosity: op25 log verbosity: 0=quiet, 1=normal, 2=verbose (tag loading), 5=debug (call/CC activity), 9=tuning details, 10=full channel-control trace (very spammy). Can be changed live from the web UI (Status tab).
